modal-main-desc:
My professional profile stems from the strategic convergence of analytical psychology and modern frontend software development.

I understand that code does not merely render interfaces on a screen; it defines how people experience, process information, and solve problems in the digital space. My technical background at Generation Colombia equipped me with industry standards, agile methodologies (Scrum), version control with Git, and contemporary web development using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript ES6+.

By combining this technical rigor with an understanding of human cognition, I design and build accessible, intuitive, and aesthetically refined products where every visual element and interaction has a clear, human-centered purpose.
modal-psico-desc:
Psychology provides a crucial competitive advantage in digital experience design. In every interface, I apply scientific principles of visual perception (Gestalt laws), cognitive load reduction, and mental models.

This allows me to anticipate user expectations and behaviors, eliminate friction points in interactive workflows, and craft natural navigation paths. It is not just about making an application visually appealing, but ensuring it feels effortless, empathetic, and intuitive from the very first moment.
modal-frontend-desc:
Frontend development is the bridge that transforms design concepts into living, dynamic, and functional experiences. My technical focus centers on writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using semantic HTML5, modern CSS3 (fluid layouts with Grid and Flexbox, CSS variables, subtle animations), and interactive JavaScript (ES6+).

I prioritize responsive design (*mobile-first*), web accessibility standards (WCAG/a11y), and load time optimization to ensure interfaces that not only look stunning, but also deliver flawless technical performance on any device.
modal-backend-desc:
A great interface requires a solid, coherent data architecture behind it. My full stack background enables me to understand the entire web application lifecycle: from efficient consumption and handling of RESTful APIs to state management, validation, and data synchronization.

With fundamentals in Java, Spring Boot, and SQL databases, I collaborate smoothly with backend engineering teams, understand the underlying data models, and ensure transparent, reliable communication between client and server.
